entries.15710e1a7b254a63: This business covers optical films and related products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue fell short of the prior year. Demand for optical films rose on strong production of high-end notebook PCs and tablets, but the decline was attributed to the strategic withdrawal from optical films for LCD smartphones and to price reductions on process protective films resulting from material cost rationalization.
entries.222ab1352150c2d3: This business covers functional films used in sanitary materials and similar products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue increased from the prior year. The company advanced sales of new sanitary materials for diapers and products contributing to the environment using biodegradable technology.

entries.417d454a1c2a721b: This business handles contract manufacturing of nucleic acids used as pharmaceutical raw materials, medical-related materials, polymer separation membranes (membranes) for water purification, and functional films used in sanitary materials such as diapers (personal care materials). Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥137,246 million, up from ¥125,570 million in the prior year (as restated).

entries.78f4eb1cb5816c33: This business covers nucleic acid contract manufacturing, nucleic acid synthesis materials, nucleic acid drug discovery, medical-related materials and related products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue increased from the prior year. Demand rose for nucleic acid contract manufacturing and the nucleic acid materials used in it (NittoPhase™), and from the second quarter of the consolidated fiscal year production began on a large project expected to be commercialized in the future. In nucleic acid drug discovery, a Phase 1 clinical trial of a drug for intractable cancer was completed in the first quarter of the prior year's consolidated fiscal year, and activities toward out-licensing continue.
entries.7e85caf2fe34d005: This business covers CIS (Circuit Integrated Suspension) and high-precision substrates. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue increased from the prior year. Demand for high-precision substrates grew with expanded production of high-end smartphones, and CIS was firm, supported by rising demand for high-capacity hard disk drives (HDDs) for data centers driven by the spread of generative AI.
entries.c536d99aa0411757: This business produces the "Foundation Functional Materials," including tapes that bond, protect and assist processing of products and parts. It includes bonding materials, protective materials, process materials and automotive materials. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥364,827 million, up from ¥348,960 million in the prior year (as restated). Demand rose for assembly components for high-end smartphones (such as expanded adoption of electrically peelable tapes for battery fixing) and for process materials used in producing semiconductor memory and ceramic capacitors. On the other hand, automotive materials declined in revenue due to lower automobile production volumes of Japanese manufacturers in China.
entries.cce5852e1956c2f6: This business covers polymer separation membranes. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue fell short of the prior year. Against a backdrop of tighter wastewater regulations, demand in China for Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) systems, which eliminate wastewater and waste liquid, remained firm, but demand for polymer separation membranes for various industrial applications declined.

entries.d2f0e2a5dce89ca5: This business handles contract manufacturing of nucleic acids used as pharmaceutical raw materials, medical-related materials, polymer separation membranes (membranes) for water purification, and functional films used in sanitary materials such as diapers (personal care materials).
entries.d45593d86e9aa3ca: This business produces optical films used in the screens of PCs, tablets and smartphones, and materials that become circuits in electronic devices (CIS and high-precision substrates). Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥524,598 million, the largest of the three reportable segments and roughly half of consolidated revenue of ¥1,028,171 million. This was down from ¥537,852 million in the prior year (as restated).
entries.dea85a6f9d34783d: A materials manufacturer that makes a wide range of functional materials, including tapes, optical films, circuit materials, contract manufacturing of nucleic acids, and polymer separation membranes.
entries.fe729c204ed46751: This is a category for new businesses and other products not included in the three reportable segments. The company is concentrating management resources on themes it positions as candidates for "PlanetFlags™/HumanFlags™" in the fields of next-generation semiconductors, environmental solutions and digital health, aiming for early commercialization. These businesses do not yet generate substantial revenue; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11 million (¥19 million in the prior year).
